npcs.name: Wren the tailor
npcs.greet: Fancy a new look, love? Pick any cut and colour you like, no charge for the first fitting.

npcs.name: Silas the mason
npcs.examine: Silas the mason. He laid the well, the two shops and the north gate, and he means you to know it.
lines: I laid that well, the two shops and the north gate. Thirty-one years, and the mortar on the gate still isn't dry.
Folk ask who made a place like this. Nobody gets a statue for it. You get a wall that still stands. Fair enough.

npcs.name: Pip the apprentice
npcs.examine: Pip the apprentice, holding something that very likely shouldn't work.
lines: You found a thing that shouldn't work? That'll be mine. I've got a list, and the list's got a list.
If a fish walks up a tree, tell me. It isn't meant to. I'd still like to see it.

npcs.name: Pax the painter
npcs.examine: Pax the painter, blue to the wrist and proud of it.
lines: Every colour in this village came through my hands. That blue on the door took me nine tries.
They wanted the sky cheaper. A cheap sky is grey weather, I told them. It's still grey weather.

npcs.name: Modulus the surveyor
npcs.examine: Modulus the surveyor, measuring the east road for the third time this morning.
lines: I measured this street at a hundred and forty-four feet. They said it needed to be a hundred and forty-three. It is, somehow.
Everything twice, once well. That's the whole trade. Count the ground before you sell it.

npcs.name: Latency the warden
npcs.examine: Latency the warden, on the north road. Late to everything, and there before you are.
lines: North gate, the torches, the path up the range. I'm late to everything and I still get there before you do.
If the road closes, that's me. If the road's fine, you never heard of me. That's the job done right.

npcs.name: Symmetry the curator
npcs.examine: Symmetry the curator, watching the way the light comes in over the lake.
lines: I keep the things that look right and I hide the ones that don't. The lake is the best thing here; it took four of us a fortnight.
The most beautiful screen is an empty one. I said so, and they gave me a room full of pots.

npcs.name: Ashvale chest
npcs.examine: The Ashvale chest. Everything you own from Ashvale is kept in your arcade wallet; this is where you see it.

npcs.name: Auditor the clerk
npcs.examine: Auditor the clerk, deep in a ledger that doesn't quite balance.
lines: Ticket, please. No? Then it's already closed and nobody told either of us.
Every coin, every catch, every word in this village gets written down somewhere. It mostly balances.
